_comment: Each rank's required adventures, spelled exactly as they appear as row labels in the Full Pack Advancement Report (advancement.json catalog.adventures[rank]). Sourced from scouting.org's official Required Adventures table (see cub-scout-adventures.md). Used to bold/flag rows as required vs. elective when rendering a den's table — match by exact string against catalog.adventures[rank]; anything present in the catalog but not listed here is an elective. Tiger has no entries: as of the 2024 Tiger Trail Cards curriculum, Tiger's required-adventure content is tracked inside the rank's own requirement rows (Tiger v2024/v2022/v2019 Req #s), not as separate adventure rows, so nothing needs to be flagged there.
